Definition: Parosh, the name of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Parosh, a name meaning flea, is the head of a large family: over two thousand of his descendants return from exile with Zerubbabel. His name stands among the chiefs of the people who seal the covenant with Nehemiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the family of Parosh shows the exiles coming home in force: two thousand strong, and they sign their name to the covenant.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
